label: Founding build
author: user
rationale: Replaces Teysa Karlov (commander made no tokens; 10 games stalled). Caesar makes two hasty Soldiers + a card or damage every attack from the command zone. Protection package keeps him alive; doublers (Procession, Mondrak, Elspeth) and attack-trigger doublers (Isshin, Windcrag Siege) scale him; Grave Pact + Dictate in per pilot 2026-09-24.

label: Founding build: Enforcer over Giver
author: user
rationale: General's Enforcer gives Caesar (a legendary Human) permanent indestructible — covers destroy-wipes, which Mother/Giver of Runes don't; Mother stays for targeted removal. 61% of Caesar decks run it.

label: FRA: Lich's Relic in, Lethal Scheme out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 (FRA set review). For {B}+{2} it destroys up to one creature or planeswalker per opponent, then stays as a +2/+1 Equipment. Like-for-like on permanent types (Lethal Scheme also hits only creatures/planeswalkers); loses instant speed and connive.

label: FRA: Bloodline Recollector in, Deadly Dispute out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 (FRA set review). Becomes prepared at EACH end step where 3+ creatures died; the prepared copy is {B}: draw three, lose 3. Repeatable draw over Deadly Dispute's one-shot. Deaths from end-step delayed sacrifices (mobilize) don't count — CR 603.4, confirmed by mtg-rules-expert.

label: FRA: Kher Keep in, one Mountain out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 (FRA set review). A land that makes a 0/1 at instant speed: sacrifice fodder and a drain on every player's turn, turns Tocasia's Welcome's once-each-turn draw into once per player's turn. Costs no spell slot.

label: Purphoros in, one Swamp out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 (pilot: 'i feel like caesar is missing purphoros'). Whenever another creature enters, 2 damage to each opponent — double Impact Tremors, and token doublers double it. Indestructible, and not a creature below 5 red devotion, so it survives creature wipes. Every role was at target and the pilot wants drain maximised, so the slot came from lands: 35 is high for a 2.69-average curve with 7 ramp pieces plus Plunderer Treasures and Smothering Tithe; 34 is standard. B sources 24 -> 23.

label: FRA: Ingris Stingerquill in, Lingering Souls out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 after keeping Bastion of Remembrance, Zulaport Cutthroat and Impact Tremors ('we need drain as much as possible'). Whenever a creature you control attacks, it deals 1 damage to each opponent — doubled by Isshin and Windcrag Siege; its {4} makes a 2/2 Cadet and gives the team haste, so it is also a repeatable token maker and the token-maker count holds. Lingering Souls was a one-shot (4 bodies over two casts). MV 3 for MV 3.

label: Chainsaw in, Talisman of Conviction out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-10. Caesar's four free outlets (Viscera Seer, Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, Goblin Bombardment) turn each mobilize Warrior into its own death event, so Chainsaw's 'one or more creatures die' rev counters climb every attack and feed Infantry Shield's mobilize X (ledger trig-021). ETB 3 damage is a sixth removal piece. Cost: ramp 7 to 6, R sources 21 to 20, W 25 to 24.

label: Troubling Tribbles in, Assemble the Legion out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (Star Trek review), taken together with the anthems. Tribbles copies itself every upkeep (15 tokens after four upkeeps for 3 mana, against Assemble's 10 for 5), and each copy triggers Purphoros, Impact Tremors and Warleader's Call. Mandatory growth: declare it at the table. Lost: an enchantment token engine that survives creature wipes, and hasty Soldiers for Myrel.

label: Caretaker's Talent in, Tocasia's Welcome out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14. Same {2}{W} once-a-turn draw, but it draws off any token entering (Treasures too, so on opponents' turns), level 2 copies a token (a Tribble keeps copying), and level 3 gives creature tokens +2/+2 so the Tribbles can attack. Cost: level 3 stops Skullclamp killing tokens, and a Class can't drop a level.

label: Heraldic Banner in, Lich's Relic out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14. Named white, +1/+0 to every Tribble and white token without stopping Skullclamp (power only), and it taps for {W}. Ramp 6 to 7, removal 6 to its target of 5. Lost: up to three targeted kills in one card (Lich's Relic, approved 2026-09-28).

label: Worf, Still Not Merry in, Hero of Bladehold out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14, keeping Secure the Wastes as the instant-speed token maker. Worf makes a flying Faerie per attacking non-Faerie creature on each attack, so a mid-game swing of 8 to 12 attackers makes 8 to 12 Faeries, each feeding Purphoros, Impact Tremors and Warleader's Call. No haste. Lost: Hero's battle cry pump and Soldiers for Myrel.

label: Vault of Champions in, one Plains out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (landbase pass). W/B land that enters untapped while you have two or more opponents. Black sources +1. Castle Ardenvale still has six Plains-typed lands.

label: Luxury Suite in, Blackcleave Cliffs out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (landbase pass). Blackcleave Cliffs enters tapped from your fourth land; Luxury Suite makes the same {B} or {R} untapped while you have two or more opponents.

label: Spectator Seating in, Inspiring Vantage out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (landbase pass). Inspiring Vantage enters tapped from your fourth land; Spectator Seating makes the same {R} or {W} untapped while you have two or more opponents.

label: Polluted Delta in, Concealed Courtyard out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (landbase pass). Concealed Courtyard enters tapped from your fourth land; Polluted Delta enters untapped and fetches Badlands, Blood Crypt, Scrubland, Godless Shrine or a Swamp, and pings with Mayhem Devil.

label: Castle Embereth in, Mountain out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-14 (landbase pass). Still taps for {R}, and {1}{R}{R} gives the team +1/+0 without stopping Skullclamp. Enters untapped with Badlands, Blood Crypt, Plateau or Sacred Foundry out. It was the last basic Mountain.

label: Lwaxana Troi in, Ingris Stingerquill out
author: user
rationale: TRK set review 2026-11-10, Lwaxana round, pilot's call 2026-11-15. Aimed at Caesar she adds one 'Whenever you attack' instance (an extra optional sacrifice and two modes; four instances with Isshin and Windcrag Siege), but not an extra reflexive 'choose two' (CR 603.2d, ledger trig-034). Aimed at Zulaport, Blood Artist or Cruel Celebrant every death drains 2. Drain & Death Payoffs was 13 against a target of 11, and Ingris fired only on declared attackers, never on Caesar's tapped-and-attacking tokens (CR 508.4). Cost: Ingris's {4} Cadet-and-haste ability and a 1/4 flying blocker.

label: Mirkwood Bats in, Zurgo Stormrender out
author: user
rationale: Star Trek review lifegain audit, pilot's call 2026-11-15. Whenever you create or sacrifice a token, each opponent loses 1; it counts every token, Treasures and doubler extras included (CR 603.2c, ledger). Zurgo drained only when a token left the battlefield while not attacking. Cost: Zurgo's draw when an attacking token leaves, its mobilize Warrior, and 1 more mana.

label: South Wind Avatar in, Swords to Plowshares out
author: user
rationale: Star Trek review lifegain audit, pilot's call 2026-11-15. The pilot picked the cut (offered: Mayhem Devil, Path to Exile). Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1, per gain event (CR 119.9, ledger dmg-001): Blood Artist, Zulaport, Cruel Celebrant, Bastion and the Avatar itself each gain on a death, Soul Warden and Elas on every creature entering. Swords gave the opponent life, which undoes drain. Cost: Removal & Interaction 5 to 4 (Anguished Unmaking, Chainsaw, Path to Exile and Vanishing Verse remain, plus the edicts).

label: Soul Warden in, General's Enforcer out
author: user
rationale: Star Trek review lifegain audit, pilot's call 2026-11-15. The pilot picked the cut. Every creature that enters, on any side, gains 1, which South Wind Avatar and Vito turn into drain; it also keeps Ocelot Pride making Cats. General's Enforcer ranked last in Protection: Mithril Coat, Flawless Maneuver and Teferi's Protection still answer destroy effects. Cost: Protection 7 to 6, and Adeline, Anim Pakal, Myrel and Commissar Raine lose indestructible.

label: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose in, Talisman of Indulgence out
author: user
rationale: Star Trek review lifegain audit, pilot's call 2026-11-15. Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much: a second converter beside South Wind Avatar. Its {3}{B}{B} gives the team lifelink, and each attacker's lifelink is a separate gain (Vito ruling). Ramp 7 for a 2.71 curve had Treasures from Plunderer, Tithe and Black Market Connections behind it. Cost: Ramp 7 to 6, red sources 21 to 20; Vito drains one opponent where the Avatar drains all three. Never add Exquisite Blood (automatic infinite with Vito).

entries.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

label: Super Shredder in, Bitterbloom Bearer out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (2026-11-15). Super Shredder gets a +1/+1 counter whenever another permanent leaves the battlefield, so every token Caesar's deck sacrifices grows it, and wearing Infantry Shield its power becomes mobilize Warriors that feed it again. Bitterblossom keeps the upkeep Faerie. Token Engines 13 -> 12 against a target of 14.

label: Founded: combat with lifelink
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (2026-11-15): keep main as the drain build and found a go-wide combat list with a lifelink layer (Sorin, Vengeful Bloodlord plus each-opponent converters). Bracket 3, Game Changers Smothering Tithe, Teferi's Protection and The One Ring. Grave Pact and Dictate stay at the pilot's request.
